messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-05-30] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Review of INC-2025-011 (Ledger, 2025-05-24). The root cause was an index missing after the schema migration. We decided that ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2026-05-19] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2025-02-05] incident-review/INC-2025-004: Incident review INC-2025-004. The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01. Root cause: a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. Decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2026-02-26] incident-review/INC-2026-003: INC-2026-003 review. What happened: the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. Why: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Follow-up decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
- [2025-10-07] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Incident review INC-2025-023. The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03. Root cause: a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. Decision: reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11: No deploys to Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-3: Heads-up from the Dune team: the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2026-03-09] handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2026-02-11: the flags service went to team Atlas, not Dune. Dune never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-2: The Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2026-06-04] standup/boreal/2026-06-04: Boreal noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2026-03-20] standup/atlas/2026-03-20: Priya runs the quarterly capacity review.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-2: The Dune team noticed that auth-gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.
- [2026-02-16] standup/dune/2026-02-16: The Dune team noticed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.
- [2026-02-03] standup/atlas/2026-02-03: The Atlas team now does a no-deploy Friday.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2: The Cinder team noticed that billing-api's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-3: Release captain for Q3 2025: Farah.
- [2026-04-03] standup/cinder/2026-04-03: Cinder runs its planning on Mondays.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2: Team Boreal noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2026-01-30] standup/cinder/2026-01-30: We agreed today that auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. The reason is that the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
- [2026-06-09] standup/dune/2026-06-09: Observation from team Dune: after the retention change, search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2026-03-03] standup/cinder/2026-03-03: The auth gateway deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus Oyelaran carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-04-08] standup/atlas/2026-04-08: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Priya. The Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-4: The Dune team planning meeting is every Wednesday.
